title: Anthropic details the AI Fluency Index, tracking 11 behaviors that represent human-AI collaboration and measure how people collaborate with AI (Anthropic)
summary: Anthropic: Anthropic details the AI Fluency Index, tracking 11 behaviors that represent human-AI collaboration and measure how people collaborate with AI — People are integrating AI tools into their daily routines at a pace that would have been difficult to predict even a year ago.
